description_en: Before using an API to edit, validate, or deploy a job draft, you must acquire an edit lock to prevent conflicts between user interface (UI) and API operations. Acquiring this lock requires either the "Develop SQL/YAML Job (Create, Edit)" or "Unlock SQL/YAML Job Draft" permission
description_zh: 当您调用API编辑、检查、部署作业草稿时，为避免页面操作和API操作互相影响，您需要先获取作业草稿锁。拥有【开发SQL/YAML作业（创建、编辑）】或【解锁SQL/YAML作业草稿】任一权限即可获取锁
kebab_example: aliyun ververica get-deployment-draft-lock --workspace a14bd5d90a0000 --namespace default-namespace --deployment-draft-id c84d73be-40ad-4627-8bdd-fa1eba51b234 --api-version 2022-07-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDeploymentDraftLock
